description: PostgreSQL: a VALUES list is an arm of a set operation and a recursive anchor; a set operation of queries in parentheses is a derived table; (TABLE t) is a subquery; schema.table.* is a star; row names a table alias and a column; a table's column alias list renames its columns; LIMIT and OFFSET take expressions over parameters; <-> is a distance, a text search phrase and pg_trgm's trigram distance; everyday built-ins, the binary string functions and jsonb path functions with variables; an argument default written with =; @name and ? are warned of as no parameters; a parameter met first as the operand of IS NULL is warned of, a cast one not.

diagnostics.messageContains: @label is no parameter here: @ before a name is the absolute value operator
the server cannot determine the type of :label
